reviewTitle: Amazing sound settings with a sleep timer
reviewDescription: I am honestly obsessed with this eye mask! It completely blocks out the light so my roommate can have the light on after I go sleep. But mainly, I LOVE all the different settings. Bluetooth works amazing, there are multiple white noise settings including beach noise which I love, and there is a sleep timer! And it’s sooo comfortable. I don’t even feel the speakers in my ear so I can sleep on my side with no problem. I’ve used it every night since I got it and I love it!

reviewTitle: Worked only 2x- silk is lovely but does not sync or work always
reviewDescription: Doesn't work unless fully charged every night and that's "maybe". Bluetooth doesn't sync at all and I wish the band in the back was Velcro or more adjustable. It feels like this is pulling when worn. The built in white noise sounds (without bluetooth) were great if you can figure out how to get them to work. The selection from the instructions didn't work always and it's just too much work in the middle of the night to figure this out and sync (which it never did sync) even if it popped up in my Bluetooth option.. it would just spin and spin.. I really wanted to like this because the 2 times it did work I tried to block out my husbands snoring.. which it did do! But hasn't worked right since. It's too bad because the silk material felt so lovely (minus the strap). So.. Only 3 stars for the silk material and the built in sound options when working.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on April 10, 2026
